messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick sync — Hummingbird Labs (trial org) onboarding week 3. Account health: OK but renewal shows signal risk if cost stays high.
Luca (Solutions Eng): Noted. Their p95 latency ~320ms and tokens/call ~2.1k, so unit cost is pushing margins.
Maya (CSM): They asked for suggestions to hit latency <250ms and ~20% cost reduction.
Riley (ML Eng): Quick thoughts: 1) Try 4-bit quantized variant for chat-heavy routes; 2) Swap short-turn flows to a trimmed-context model variant; 3) Route high-throughput endpoints to Dedicated pool during 9–17 PST.
Maya (CSM): @Riley can you estimate perf delta and compatibility with their eval set?
Riley (ML Eng): Yep — rough numbers from bench: int8 -> ~1.2x throughput, 4-bit -> ~1.6x, latency drop ~30–40ms p95 for typical prompts. Quality impact depends on prompt length; I'll run their 500-sample eval. ETA ~3 hrs.
Luca (Solutions Eng): For safe rollout, we can do canary rules and traffic split. Example route rule: 
```
route_rules:
  - name: hummingbird_peak
    match: headers.x-customer-route == "hummingbird_peak"
    action: route_to(dedicated: hummingbird-pool)
```
Maya (CSM): Nice. @Sam can you schedule a 30min enablement w/ Hummingbird support staff to explain tradeoffs and rollback?
Sam (Account Exec): On it — booking Thu 10am PST. Adding agenda: quant tradeoffs, routing config, fallback plan.
Aisha (Product): Suggest we ship a tiny feedback survey + collect a 5–10 item eval set from their PMs so we can quantify any user-facing regressions. Critical for renewal talks.
Riley (ML Eng): I'll push pre/post eval metrics to #eng-ml and link here. If quality delta >2% (syntactic/semantic score) we hold swap.
OnboardingBot: Reminder: enablement session created for Hummingbird Labs — Thu 10:00 PST (link: https://calendar.example/evt/123)
Maya (CSM): Thanks all — plan I'll share with customer: run 4-bit validation, swap short-turn routes to trimmed model, add routing rule for peak hours, canary rollout with telemetry, enablement Thurs. I'll update thread when evals land. :thumbsup:
